summary: Eoghan O’Flanagan’s Shin to Shin covers seated engagement, heisting and entries against different stances.
description: A seated-guard course on making contact, entering shin-to-shin and handling the opponent’s responses.
overview: Shin to Shin spends substantial time on the engagement before the leg connection: posture, foot tracking, hand fighting and heisting. Eoghan O’Flanagan then covers entries against square and bladed stances, followed by responses to pummeling, guillotines and backsteps. The course suits a player whose difficulty starts before a secure leg entry.

guide.display_title: Eoghan O’Flanagan: Shin-to-Shin and Seated Engagement

fits: Posts, hand fighting or stance changes prevent you from reaching shin-to-shin.

includes: Posture, foot tracking, hand fighting, heisting and ankle picks.
Shin-to-shin entries against different stances and responses to pummeling and backsteps.
limits: The detailed outline centers on engagement, entries and counters rather than a dedicated series of leg-lock finishes.
